descripcion: Cifras publicadas del GlucoWatch Biographer (Cygnus, 2001) y del GlucoWatch G2 Biographer (2002), cada una con su cita literal y su fuente. Las usa glucowatch.md, que cita cada cifra por su id.
metodo: Dos barridos independientes: literatura revisada por pares (Europe PMC, PubMed y PMC, ids C) y documentos regulatorios, del fabricante, financieros y de prensa (FDA, openFDA, SEC EDGAR, Wayback Machine de glucowatch.com, patentes, ids R). Las citas van en el idioma original. Las cifras C82 y C91 se contrastaron ademas con los resumenes de PubMed (PMID 14988292 y 15628809).

claves.param: parametro, con el grupo como prefijo en C
claves.condiciones: poblacion, n, entorno, referencia y definicion
claves.tipo: clase de dato o de fuente

limites: La literatura clinica se leyo sobre todo en resumenes cuando el texto completo no estaba abierto (Tamada 1999, Garg 1999, Pitzer 2001, Eastman 2002, Chase 2005, entre otros). Del resumen de seguridad y eficacia original (P990026b) solo se leyeron las paginas 1 a 5, 7 y 9. No se encontraron tamano ni peso del reloj ni los umbrales numericos del detector de sudor.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Diferencia absoluta relativa media (MARD) vs HemoCue
clinica.condiciones: 92 adultos (edad media 42,1 ±15,1 años) con DM1/DM2 en insulina; 2 centros de diabetes y 3 CRO en EE. UU.; sesiones de 15 h, 2 punciones/h; referencia HemoCue; 2167 pares; calibración con 1 punto tras 3 h de calentamiento
clinica.cita: The mean absolute error between the 2 measurements was 15.6% (mean error [SD], -0.07 [1.82] mmol/L [-1 [33] mg/dL])
clinica.fuente: Tamada, J. A., Garg, S., Jovanovic, L., Pitzer, K. R., Fermi, S., & Potts, R. O. (1999). Noninvasive glucose monitoring: Comprehensive clinical results. JAMA, 282(19), 1839-1844.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Error medio (sesgo)
clinica.condiciones: Igual que arriba: n=92, 2167 pares, HemoCue
clinica.cita: mean error [SD], -0.07 [1.82] mmol/L [-1 [33] mg/dL]
clinica.fuente: Tamada, J. A., Garg, S., Jovanovic, L., Pitzer, K. R., Fermi, S., & Potts, R. O. (1999). Noninvasive glucose monitoring: Comprehensive clinical results. JAMA, 282(19), 1839-1844.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Correlación, pendiente e intercepto (regresión de Deming)
clinica.condiciones: Igual: n=92, 2167 pares, rango 40-400 mg/dL, HemoCue
clinica.cita: linear relationship (r = 0.88; slope = 1.03; intercept = -0.33 mmol/L [-6 mg/dL]) between biographer readings and serial glucose measurements
clinica.fuente: Tamada, J. A., Garg, S., Jovanovic, L., Pitzer, K. R., Fermi, S., & Potts, R. O. (1999). Noninvasive glucose monitoring: Comprehensive clinical results. JAMA, 282(19), 1839-1844.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Zonas A+B de la cuadrícula de Clarke
clinica.condiciones: Igual: n=92, 2167 pares, HemoCue, Clarke
clinica.cita: 96.8% of the data fell in the therapeutically relevant regions of the error grid analysis
clinica.fuente: Tamada, J. A., Garg, S., Jovanovic, L., Pitzer, K. R., Fermi, S., & Potts, R. O. (1999). Noninvasive glucose monitoring: Comprehensive clinical results. JAMA, 282(19), 1839-1844.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Correlación con HemoCue en clínica
clinica.condiciones: 28 adultos jóvenes DM1 (edad 30,9 ±6,9 años), 76 biógrafos en clínica ambulatoria, 1554 pares; referencia capilar HemoCue
clinica.cita: correlated well with capillary blood glucose values determined using the HemoCue analyzer in the clinic setting (r = 0.90, 1,554 paired data points)
clinica.fuente: Garg, S. K., Potts, R. O., Ackerman, N. R., Fermi, S. J., Tamada, J. A., & Chase, H. P. (1999). Correlation of fingerstick blood glucose measurements with GlucoWatch biographer glucose results in young subjects with type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 22(10), 1708-1714.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Correlación con glucómetro en casa
clinica.condiciones: 12 sujetos, 1 biógrafo/día por 3 días en casa; 204 pares; referencia One Touch Profile
clinica.cita: using the One Touch Profile meter in the home setting (r = 0.85, 204 paired data points)
clinica.fuente: Garg, S. K., Potts, R. O., Ackerman, N. R., Fermi, S. J., Tamada, J. A., & Chase, H. P. (1999). Correlation of fingerstick blood glucose measurements with GlucoWatch biographer glucose results in young subjects with type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 22(10), 1708-1714.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Correlación entre dos biógrafos simultáneos (precisión)
clinica.condiciones: 36 sujetos con dos biógrafos a la vez (antebrazo)
clinica.cita: When 36 subjects wore two biographers simultaneously, the correlation between the two biographers was r = 0.94.
clinica.fuente: Garg, S. K., Potts, R. O., Ackerman, N. R., Fermi, S. J., Tamada, J. A., & Chase, H. P. (1999). Correlation of fingerstick blood glucose measurements with GlucoWatch biographer glucose results in young subjects with type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 22(10), 1708-1714.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Zonas A+B de Clarke (clínica y casa)
clinica.condiciones: Clínica (HemoCue) y casa (One Touch Profile); mismos sujetos que arriba
clinica.cita: > 96% of biographer glucose values determined in the clinic or home setting were in the clinically acceptable A and B regions
clinica.fuente: Garg, S. K., Potts, R. O., Ackerman, N. R., Fermi, S. J., Tamada, J. A., & Chase, H. P. (1999). Correlation of fingerstick blood glucose measurements with GlucoWatch biographer glucose results in young subjects with type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 22(10), 1708-1714.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Diferencia media en casa y Clarke A+B
clinica.condiciones: Entorno doméstico, glucemia capilar seriada; revisión de los estudios clínicos de Cygnus
clinica.cita: Mean difference between these measurements was 0.26 mmol/L in the home environment (r = 0.80). Over 94% of biographer readings were in the clinically acceptable A+B region
clinica.fuente: Tierney, M. J., Tamada, J. A., Potts, R. O., Eastman, R. C., Pitzer, K., Ackerman, N. R., & Fermi, S. J. (2000). The GlucoWatch biographer: A frequent automatic and noninvasive glucose monitor. Annals of Medicine, 32(9), 632-641.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Precisión (CV%) y sesgo a glucosa baja
clinica.valor: CV ~10; sesgo positivo a glucosa baja
clinica.condiciones: Revisión; comparación con punciones seriadas
clinica.cita: A slight positive bias is observed for the biographer readings at low glucose levels. Biographer precision, as measured by coefficient of variation (CV)%, is approximately 10%.
clinica.fuente: Tierney, M. J., Tamada, J. A., Potts, R. O., Eastman, R. C., Pitzer, K., Ackerman, N. R., & Fermi, S. J. (2000). The GlucoWatch biographer: A frequent automatic and noninvasive glucose monitor. Annals of Medicine, 32(9), 632-641.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Diferencia media biógrafo-punción (clínica / casa)
clinica.condiciones: Dos estudios: entorno clínico controlado n=231; casa n=124; referencia punción seriada
clinica.cita: Mean difference between biographer and finger-stick measurements was -0.01 and 0.26 mmol l(-1) for the clinical and home environments, respectively.
clinica.fuente: Tierney, M. J., Tamada, J. A., Potts, R. O., Jovanovic, L., Garg, S., & Cygnus Research Team. (2001). Clinical evaluation of the GlucoWatch biographer: A continual, non-invasive glucose monitor for patients with diabetes. Biosensors & Bioelectronics, 16(9-12), 621-629.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Valor absoluto de la diferencia relativa (clínica / casa), tal como se reporta
clinica.condiciones: n=231 clínica; n=124 casa
clinica.cita: The mean absolute value of the relative difference was 1.06 and 1.18 mmol l(-1) for the same studies.
clinica.fuente: Tierney, M. J., Tamada, J. A., Potts, R. O., Jovanovic, L., Garg, S., & Cygnus Research Team. (2001). Clinical evaluation of the GlucoWatch biographer: A continual, non-invasive glucose monitor for patients with diabetes. Biosensors & Bioelectronics, 16(9-12), 621-629.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Correlación (clínica / casa)
clinica.condiciones: n=231 clínica; n=124 casa; punción capilar
clinica.cita: Correlation coefficient (r) between biographer and finger-stick measurements was 0.85 and 0.80 for the two studies.
clinica.fuente: Tierney, M. J., Tamada, J. A., Potts, R. O., Jovanovic, L., Garg, S., & Cygnus Research Team. (2001). Clinical evaluation of the GlucoWatch biographer: A continual, non-invasive glucose monitor for patients with diabetes. Biosensors & Bioelectronics, 16(9-12), 621-629.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Clarke A+B y CV
clinica.condiciones: Ambos estudios (clínica y casa)
clinica.cita: In both studies, over 94% of the biographer readings were in the clinically acceptable A+B region of the Clarke Error Grid.
clinica.fuente: Tierney, M. J., Tamada, J. A., Potts, R. O., Jovanovic, L., Garg, S., & Cygnus Research Team. (2001). Clinical evaluation of the GlucoWatch biographer: A continual, non-invasive glucose monitor for patients with diabetes. Biosensors & Bioelectronics, 16(9-12), 621-629.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Exactitud según velocidad de cambio de glucemia
clinica.valor: constante salvo caída >10 mmol/L/h (0,2% de los puntos en casa)
clinica.condiciones: Estudio en casa n=124
clinica.cita: Biographer accuracy is relatively constant over all rates of BG changes, except when BG decreases more than 10 mmol l(-1) h(-1), which occurred for only 0.2% of points in the home environment study.
clinica.fuente: Tierney, M. J., Tamada, J. A., Potts, R. O., Jovanovic, L., Garg, S., & Cygnus Research Team. (2001). Clinical evaluation of the GlucoWatch biographer: A continual, non-invasive glucose monitor for patients with diabetes. Biosensors & Bioelectronics, 16(9-12), 621-629.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Diferencia media con paracetamol 1000 mg
clinica.condiciones: 18 adultos con diabetes; dosis para Cmax en la calibración o en la medición; punción seriada; 9 h
clinica.cita: The mean difference between the two measurements is between 8 and 12 mg/dL for all groups.
clinica.fuente: Tierney, M. J., Garg, S., Ackerman, N. R., Fermi, S. J., Kennedy, J., Lopatin, M., Potts, R. O., & Tamada, J. A. (2000). Effect of acetaminophen on the accuracy of glucose measurements obtained with the GlucoWatch biographer. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 2(2), 199-207.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · MARD y Clarke A+B con paracetamol
clinica.condiciones: n=18; sin diferencias significativas entre grupos
clinica.cita: The mean absolute value of the relative difference is less than 20%, and more than 93% of the points were in the clinically acceptable (A+B) region of the Clarke Error Grid.
clinica.fuente: Tierney, M. J., Garg, S., Ackerman, N. R., Fermi, S. J., Kennedy, J., Lopatin, M., Potts, R. O., & Tamada, J. A. (2000). Effect of acetaminophen on the accuracy of glucose measurements obtained with the GlucoWatch biographer. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 2(2), 199-207.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · MARD, antebrazo, niños y adolescentes
clinica.condiciones: 66 niños/adolescentes con diabetes, 3 biógrafos c/u (antebrazo, brazo, pierna, torso), hasta 12 h; referencia HemoCue horaria
clinica.cita: For forearm biographers, the mean absolute relative difference between biographer readings and blood glucose was 21%.
clinica.fuente: Eastman, R. C., Chase, H. P., Buckingham, B., Hathout, E. H., Fuller-Byk, L., Leptien, A., et al. (2002). Use of the GlucoWatch biographer in children and adolescents with diabetes. Pediatric Diabetes, 3(3), 127-134.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Clarke A+B y consenso A+B, antebrazo
clinica.condiciones: Mismo estudio pediátrico; otros sitios anatómicos con datos similares
clinica.cita: Ninety-five per cent of biographer readings fell into the A or B regions of the Clarke error grid, and 97.3% into the A or B regions of the consensus error grid.
clinica.fuente: Eastman, R. C., Chase, H. P., Buckingham, B., Hathout, E. H., Fuller-Byk, L., Leptien, A., et al. (2002). Use of the GlucoWatch biographer in children and adolescents with diabetes. Pediatric Diabetes, 3(3), 127-134.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Correlación, MARD y A+B (repetición de datos de Tamada 1999)
clinica.condiciones: 92 sujetos diabéticos, entorno clínico, calibración con 1 valor
clinica.cita: An analysis of data from 92 diabetic subjects in a controlled clinical setting shows a linear relationship (r=0.88) between GlucoWatch biographer readings and blood glucose.
clinica.fuente: Potts, R. O., Tamada, J. A., & Tierney, M. J. (2002). Glucose monitoring by reverse iontophoresis. Diabetes/Metabolism Research and Reviews, 18(Suppl 1), S49-S53.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Mediana de la diferencia relativa absoluta (RAD)
clinica.condiciones: 89 niños/adolescentes DM1 (3,5-17,7 años; media 9,9), 174 GW2B, estancia de 24 h en centro de investigación clínica; 3672 pares; referencia suero por hexoquinasa en laboratorio central; lag de 17,5 min aplicado; pareo ±5 min (±2,5 min en pruebas de hiper/hipoglucemia)
clinica.cita: The median relative absolute difference between the GW2B and reference glucose values was 16% (25th, 75th percentiles = 7%, 29%).
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · RAD media
clinica.condiciones: Mismo estudio DirecNet, 3672 pares
clinica.cita: Relative Absolute Difference 22% (20%, 23%) | 16% (7%, 29%)
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Diferencia con la referencia (sensor menos referencia)
clinica.condiciones: Mismo estudio, 3672 pares
clinica.cita: The median difference between glucose sensor and reference glucose levels was 3 mg/dL and the mean difference was 2.2 mg/dL (not significantly different than 0 mg/dL)
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Diferencia absoluta
clinica.condiciones: Mismo estudio, 3672 pares
clinica.cita: Absolute Difference mg/dL 30.9 (28.7, 33.2) | 23 (11, 42)
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Cumplimiento de criterios ISO propuestos
clinica.condiciones: ISO propuesto: ref ≤75 mg/dL, GW2B ±15 mg/dL; ref >75 mg/dL, GW2B ±20%; 3672 pares
clinica.cita: The proposed International Organisation for Standardisation criteria were met for 60% of sensor values.
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Correlación de Pearson con la referencia
clinica.condiciones: 3672 pares, correlación agrupada sin ajuste por sujeto
clinica.cita: The Pearson correlation between the paired GW2B and reference glucose values was 0.86 and the ISO criteria were met for 60% of sensor values.
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Cuadrícula de consenso (modificada de Clarke)
clinica.condiciones: 3672 pares
clinica.cita: Sixty-seven percent of sensor values were within zone A of the modified error grid and 97% were within zones A + B.
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · RAD e ISO con glucosa de referencia ≤70 mg/dL
clinica.condiciones: 334 pares con referencia ≤70 mg/dL
clinica.cita: Serum Glucose Level (mg/dL) <0.001/< 0.001 ≤70 334 38% 32%
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · RAD e ISO por rangos de glucosa 71-120 / 121-180 / 181-240 / >240 mg/dL
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · RAD e ISO en prueba de hipoglucemia / hiperglucemia
clinica.valor: hipo: RAD 20, ISO 52; hiper: RAD 15, ISO 66
clinica.condiciones: 482 pares en hipoglucemia inducida por insulina; 417 en hiperglucemia por comida
clinica.cita: Hypoglycemia Test 482 20% 52% ... Hyperglycemia Test 417 15% 66%
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · RAD e ISO según edad del sensor (0-<6 h / 6-<10 h / ≥10 h)
clinica.cita: Accuracy degraded slightly as the sensor pad aged (Table 3).
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Rendimiento nocturno vs diurno (RAD / ISO)
clinica.condiciones: Solo muestras horarias/semihorarias; n=1530 noche, 1123 día
clinica.cita: GW2B accuracy showed no meaningful variation according to time of day, subject age, gender, or BMI (Table 3).
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · RAD e ISO por grupo de edad (1-<7 / 7-<12 / 12-<18 años)
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Solo sensores con una única calibración
clinica.condiciones: Subconjunto de sensores con 1 valor de calibración
clinica.cita: When the analyses were limited to the sensor pads with only a single calibration value, the median RAD was 17%, and 57% of the sensor values met ISO criteria.
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Variación entre sensores (mediana RAD por sensor)
clinica.valor: RAD <10: 26% de sensores; <20: 68%; ≥30: 13%; ISO ≥80% en 27% de sensores, <50% en 30%
clinica.condiciones: 171 sensores con ≥10 pares
clinica.cita: 26% had a median RAD <10% whereas 13% had a median RAD ≥30%
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Precisión entre dos GW2B simultáneos
clinica.valor: r=0,85; 64% dentro de 20%; RAD mediana 15% (7-26); diferencia abs. mediana 21 mg/dL; 36% / 51% dentro de 10% / 15%
clinica.condiciones: 2815 pares de valores de dos sensores; concordantes por edad de sensor: 873 pares, r=0,89, 74% dentro de 20%
clinica.cita: The Pearson correlation of the paired sensor values was 0.85, but only 64% of values were within 20% of each other.
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · COMPARADOR CGMS: mediana RAD (artículo compañero del mismo estudio DirecNet)
clinica.condiciones: 91 niños/adolescentes DM1, 6778 pares CGMS-referencia; sensores modificados (nov 2002) RAD mediana 11% vs 19% originales
clinica.cita: The median relative absolute difference (RAD) between the CGMS and reference values was 18% (25th, 75th percentiles = 8%, 34%).
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the CGMS in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 781-789.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Diferencia absoluta mediana en hipoglucemia (ref ≤60 mg/dL)
clinica.condiciones: 192 pares GW2B-referencia con ref ≤60 mg/dL; 91 niños/adolescentes DM1 (3,5-17,7 años), estancia de 24 h
clinica.cita: For the 192 reference glucose values ≤60 mg/dL, the median absolute difference of the GW2B values was 26 mg/dL; 31% of sensor values were within 15 mg/dL of the reference value.
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2004). Accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 Biographer and the continuous glucose monitoring system during hypoglycemia: Experience of the Diabetes Research in Children Network. Diabetes Care, 27(3), 722-726.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · % dentro de 15 mg/dL en hipoglucemia
clinica.condiciones: 192 pares con ref ≤60 mg/dL
clinica.cita: with 31 and 42%, respectively, of the sensor values within 15 mg/dL of the reference glucose
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2004). Accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 Biographer and the continuous glucose monitoring system during hypoglycemia: Experience of the Diabetes Research in Children Network. Diabetes Care, 27(3), 722-726.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · COMPARADOR CGMS en hipoglucemia: diferencia absoluta mediana y % dentro de 15 mg/dL
clinica.condiciones: 401 pares CGMS-referencia con ref ≤60 mg/dL; sensores originales 20 vs modificados 15 mg/dL (356 y 45 pares)
clinica.cita: the median absolute difference between the 192 GW2B reference glucose pairs was 26 mg/dl and between the 401 CGMS reference glucose pairs was 19 mg/dl
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2004). Accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 Biographer and the continuous glucose monitoring system during hypoglycemia: Experience of the Diabetes Research in Children Network. Diabetes Care, 27(3), 722-726.

clinica.condiciones: 34 sujetos, 48 GW2B en prueba IV de insulina; comparador CGMS originales (51 sensores): nadir ≤60 en 51%, 61-80 en 22%, 81-100 en 24%
clinica.cita: the GW2B nadir was also ≤60 mg/dL for 12 (25%) cases, 61–80 mg/dL for 27 (56%), 81–100 mg/dL for 8 (17%), and >100 mg/dL for 1 (2%)
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2004). Accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 Biographer and the continuous glucose monitoring system during hypoglycemia: Experience of the Diabetes Research in Children Network. Diabetes Care, 27(3), 722-726.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Diferencia absoluta mediana en niños sanos no diabéticos
clinica.condiciones: 15 niños sanos (9-17 años; 11 varones), 24 h, 39 sensores, 487 pares (286 nocturnos); referencia suero horaria de día y cada 30 min de noche
clinica.cita: the median absolute difference in concentrations measured by the GW2B (487 pairs) was 13 mg/dL
clinica.fuente: Mauras, N., Beck, R. W., Ruedy, K. J., Kollman, C., Tamborlane, W. V., Chase, H. P., et al. (2004). The Journal of Pediatrics, 144(6), 770-775.

clinica.cita: The GW2B values were within 10 mg/dL of the reference values 40% of the time and within 20 mg/dL 70% of the time.
clinica.fuente: Mauras, N., Beck, R. W., Ruedy, K. J., Kollman, C., Tamborlane, W. V., Chase, H. P., et al. (2004). clinica.param: EXACTITUD · COMPARADOR CGMS en niños sanos
clinica.valor: mediana abs. 17 mg/dL; dentro de 10: 34%; dentro de 20: 58%; >20 mg/dL: 42%
clinica.condiciones: 668 pares CGMS-referencia; sensores modificados: mediana 11 mg/dL, 48% y 72% dentro de 10 y 20 mg/dL (71 pares)
clinica.cita: the difference measured by the CGMS was 17 mg/dL (668 pairs), with 30% and 42% of values using the GW2B and CGMS, respectively, deviating >20 mg/dL from the reference value
clinica.fuente: Mauras, N., Beck, R. W., Ruedy, K. J., Kollman, C., Tamborlane, W. V., Chase, H. P., et al. (2004). Lack of accuracy of continuous glucose sensors in healthy, nondiabetic children: Results of the Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) accuracy study. The Journal of Pediatrics, 144(6), 770-775.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Lecturas espurias <60 mg/dL en niños sanos
clinica.valor: GW2B: 73% de sujetos con ≥1 valor <60; 108 valores <60 (11/15 sujetos); en los 33 emparejados con referencia la referencia fue 74-107 mg/dL
clinica.condiciones: 15 niños sanos; CGMS comparador: 60% de sujetos, 134 valores <60, referencia 82-105 mg/dL en los 14 emparejados
clinica.cita: The GW2B reported values <60 mg/dL in 73% of subjects, the CGMS in 60% of subjects. In none of these episodes was serum glucose truly low.
clinica.fuente: Mauras, N., Beck, R. W., Ruedy, K. J., Kollman, C., Tamborlane, W. V., Chase, H. P., et al. (2004). Lack of accuracy of continuous glucose sensors in healthy, nondiabetic children: Results of the Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) accuracy study. The Journal of Pediatrics, 144(6), 770-775.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Correlación vs glucómetro en casa, por edad
clinica.condiciones: 46 niños DM1 de 1-17 años (15 <7 años, 31 ≥7 años); 531 pares GW2B/glucómetro; uso domiciliario durante 3 meses
clinica.cita: A total of 531 paired GW2B/meter readings were available for accuracy assessment. The correlation coefficients were 0.58 and 0.74 (ages <7 and > or =7 years, respectively).
clinica.fuente: Hathout, E., Patel, N., Southern, C., Hill, J., Anderson, R., Sharkey, J., et al. (2005). Home use of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with diabetes. Pediatrics, 115(3), 662-666.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Correlación biógrafo-glucómetro de antebrazo durante ejercicio
clinica.condiciones: 4 sujetos DM1 y 5 controles sin diabetes; reposo y ejercicio leve, moderado, intenso, en interior y exterior; glucómetro de antebrazo (sitio alternativo)
clinica.cita: A weak association between GlucoWatch and matched glucometer readings (r = 0.81; P < 0.01) was found.
clinica.fuente: Nunnold, T., Colberg, S. R., Herriott, M. T., & Somma, C. T. (2004). Use of the noninvasive GlucoWatch Biographer during exercise of varying intensity. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 6(4), 454-462.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Correlación con glucómetro en campamento (valores 11-20 min después)
clinica.condiciones: 45 campistas de 7-17 años, 154 noches, alarma baja a 85 mg/dL; glucómetro
clinica.cita: Reported biographer values correlated with meter glucose values measured 11 to 20 minutes later (r = 0.90).
clinica.fuente: Gandrud, L. M., Paguntalan, H. U., Van Wyhe, M. M., Kunselman, B. L., Leptien, A. D., Wilson, D. M., Eastman, R. C., & Buckingham, B. A. (2004). Use of the Cygnus GlucoWatch biographer at a diabetes camp. Pediatrics, 113(1 Pt 1), 108-111.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Tasas de cambio de glucosa medidas con el biógrafo (antes / después del almuerzo)
clinica.condiciones: 124 adultos DM1/DM2 con insulina, 5 días consecutivos en casa, punciones horarias; otro estudio con 134 sujetos para día/noche
clinica.cita: -0.36 +/- 0.95 and 0.36 +/- 0.99 mg. dl(-1). min(-1) were found before and after lunch using blood glucose data and -0.31 +/- 1.23 and 0.43 +/- 1.26 using Biographer data.
clinica.fuente: Dunn, T. C., Eastman, R. C., & Tamada, J. A. (2004). Rates of glucose change measured by blood glucose meter and the GlucoWatch Biographer during day, night, and around mealtimes. Diabetes Care, 27(9), 2161-2165.

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · AUC de la curva ROC con datos reales GW2B (hipo ≤60 / hiper >300 mg/dL)
clinica.condiciones: Datos del estudio de exactitud DirecNet; apareamientos aleatorizados dieron AUC 64% (hipo) y 68% (hiper)
clinica.cita: The actual GWB-reference pairs had AUC values of 88% and 93%, respectively
clinica.fuente: Kollman, C., Wilson, D. M., Wysocki, T., Tamborlane, W. V., Beck, R. W., & Diabetes Research in Children Network Study Group. (2005). Limitations of statistical measures of error in assessing the accuracy of continuous glucose sensors. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 7(5), 665-672.
clinica.ubicacion: Resultados, ROC (texto de la sección ROC)

clinica.param: EXACTITUD · Simulación con GW2B: pares barajados aún caen en zonas A+B
clinica.condiciones: Simulación con datos de exactitud DirecNet con parejas sensor-referencia mezcladas al azar; 1000 simulaciones
clinica.cita: Sensors that were made artificially inaccurate by randomly shuffling the pairings to reference values still fell in Zone A or B 78% of the time for the Clarke grid and 79% of the time for the modified grid.
clinica.fuente: Kollman, C., Wilson, D. M., Wysocki, T., Tamborlane, W. V., Beck, R. W., & Diabetes Research in Children Network Study Group. (2005). Limitations of statistical measures of error in assessing the accuracy of continuous glucose sensors. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 7(5), 665-672.

clinica.param: TIEMPOS · Retraso frente a la sangre (media)
clinica.condiciones: 92 adultos, 15 h en clínica; referencia punción seriada
clinica.cita: The biographer readings lagged behind serial blood glucose values by a mean of 18 minutes.
clinica.fuente: Tamada, J. A., Garg, S., Jovanovic, L., Pitzer, K. R., Fermi, S., & Potts, R. O. (1999). Noninvasive glucose monitoring: Comprehensive clinical results. JAMA, 282(19), 1839-1844.

clinica.param: TIEMPOS · Retraso total, instrumental y fisiológico
clinica.condiciones: Sujetos con diabetes; índice de sensibilidad normalizado de dos puntos (NSI) entre señal intersticial y glucemia
clinica.cita: Results show an average total lag of 17.2 +/- 7.2 min for all subjects evaluated. The instrumental lag was 13.5 min, suggesting that physiological lag is approximately 5 min.
clinica.fuente: Kulcu, E., Tamada, J. A., Reach, G., Potts, R. O., & Lesho, M. J. (2003). Physiological differences between interstitial glucose and blood glucose measured in human subjects. Diabetes Care, 26(8), 2405-2409.

clinica.param: TIEMPOS · Retraso del GW2B aplicado en el análisis
clinica.condiciones: Punto medio de 15-20 min propuesto por el fabricante; usado en el pareo
clinica.cita: The reported glucose value lags behind the blood glucose level by about 17.5 minutes.
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: TIEMPOS · Calentamiento y intervalo entre lecturas GW1 vs GW2B; vida máxima del sensor
clinica.valor: calentamiento 3 h (GW1) vs 2 h (GW2B); lectura cada 20 vs 10 min; vida máxima 15 h
clinica.condiciones: Descripción del dispositivo en artículo DirecNet
clinica.cita: the software of the GW2B model allows for a 2-hour instead of a 3-hour warm up and provides glucose readings every 10 minutes instead of every 20 minutes.
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: TIEMPOS · Duración y frecuencia de lecturas GW1
clinica.condiciones: Estudios clínico (n=231) y domiciliario (n=124)
clinica.cita: The biographer can provide glucose readings every 20 min for 12 h.
clinica.fuente: Tierney, M. J., Tamada, J. A., Potts, R. O., Jovanovic, L., Garg, S., & Cygnus Research Team. (2001). Clinical evaluation of the GlucoWatch biographer: A continual, non-invasive glucose monitor for patients with diabetes. Biosensors & Bioelectronics, 16(9-12), 621-629.

clinica.param: TIEMPOS · Duración por sensor y retraso en el GW2B (descripción)
clinica.valor: calentamiento 2 h; lectura cada 10 min; hasta 13 h; alarma de hipoglucemia refleja la glucemia de ~18 min antes; down alert anticipa 20 min
clinica.condiciones: Descripción en estudio de alarmas nocturnas
clinica.cita: After a 2-hour warm up, the GW2B provides glucose readings every 10 minutes for up to 13 hours.
clinica.fuente: Buckingham, B., Block, J., Burdick, J., Kalajian, A., Kollman, C., Choy, M., Wilson, D. M., Chase, P., & Diabetes Research in Children Network. (2005). Response to nocturnal alarms using a real-time glucose sensor. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 7(3), 440-447.

clinica.param: TIEMPOS · Frecuencia y duración (GW1, estudio paracetamol)
clinica.condiciones: Descripción del dispositivo
clinica.cita: providing automatic, frequent, and noninvasive glucose readings up to three times per hour for as long as 12 hours
clinica.fuente: Tierney, M. J., Garg, S., Ackerman, N. R., Fermi, S. J., Kennedy, J., Lopatin, M., Potts, R. O., & Tamada, J. A. (2000). Effect of acetaminophen on the accuracy of glucose measurements obtained with the GlucoWatch biographer. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 2(2), 199-207.

clinica.param: CALIBRACIÓN · Esquema de calibración (1 valor tras calentamiento)
clinica.condiciones: Calibración con una medición HemoCue; seguimiento hasta 12 h
clinica.cita: The biographers were calibrated with a single HemoCue measurement after a 3-hour warm-up period.
clinica.fuente: Tamada, J. A., Garg, S., Jovanovic, L., Pitzer, K. R., Fermi, S., & Potts, R. O. (1999). Noninvasive glucose monitoring: Comprehensive clinical results. JAMA, 282(19), 1839-1844.

clinica.param: CALIBRACIÓN · Éxito de calibración al primer intento
clinica.condiciones: Excluye momentos con glucemia fuera de rango (>279 o <41 mg/dL); 5 de los otros 16 calibraron luego; 11 casos sin calibrar
clinica.cita: Sensor calibration was successful on the first attempt for 269 (94%) of the 285 sensors
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: CALIBRACIÓN · Fallas de inicio por error de alto voltaje
clinica.condiciones: Inicio fallido del GW2B en el estudio de exactitud
clinica.cita: In two subjects, both African Americans, GW2B initiation was unsuccessful due to a high voltage error messages
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: CALIBRACIÓN · Vida funcional de los sensores calibrados
clinica.condiciones: 113 sensores calibrados no retirados prematuramente por logística
clinica.cita: the sensor functioned for its full life span (≥14.5 hours from initiation) in 92 (81%), 10.0 to <14.5 hours in 3 (3%), 6.0 to <10.0 hours in 7 (6%), and <6.0 hours in 11 (10%)
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: CALIBRACIÓN · Biógrafos calibrados tras el calentamiento y noches completas
clinica.valor: calibrados 67%; usados toda la noche (12 h) 28% de los calibrados
clinica.condiciones: 45 campistas, 154 noches; biógrafo puesto a las 18:00
clinica.cita: After a 3-hour warm-up period, 67% of biographers were calibrated, of which 28% were worn the entire night (12 hours).
clinica.fuente: Gandrud, L. M., Paguntalan, H. U., Van Wyhe, M. M., Kunselman, B. L., Leptien, A. D., Wilson, D. M., Eastman, R. C., & Buckingham, B. A. (2004). Use of the Cygnus GlucoWatch biographer at a diabetes camp. Pediatrics, 113(1 Pt 1), 108-111.

clinica.param: DATOS PERDIDOS · Lecturas saltadas (todas las edades de sensor)
clinica.condiciones: Entre calibración y apagado/retiro; 89 niños, 24 h
clinica.cita: Among the 14,224 possible sensor glucose measurements between the time of calibration and the shut off, removal of the sensor or end of study, 2,369 (17%) were skipped.
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: DATOS PERDIDOS · Lecturas saltadas durante la prueba de hipoglucemia
clinica.condiciones: 66 GW2B en 46 sujetos de 7,1-17,7 años; desde el bolo de insulina hasta 30 min tras el nadir
clinica.cita: Of the total 530 possible GW2B sensor readings during the test, 501 (95%) were available for analysis and 29 (5%) were missed due to skips.
clinica.fuente: Tsalikian, E., Kollman, C., Mauras, N., Weinzimer, S., Buckingham, B., Xing, D., et al. (2004). GlucoWatch G2 Biographer alarm reliability during hypoglycemia in children. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 6(5), 559-566.
clinica.ubicacion: Métodos (análisis de la prueba de insulina)

clinica.param: DATOS PERDIDOS · Lecturas saltadas en campamento y causas
clinica.valor: 34% saltadas; causas: errores de datos 65%, sudor 20%, cambio de temperatura 16%
clinica.condiciones: 45 campistas, 154 noches, entorno no clínico con actividades
clinica.cita: Thirty-four percent of readings were skipped because of: "data errors" (65%), sweat (20%), and temperature change (16%).
clinica.fuente: Gandrud, L. M., Paguntalan, H. U., Van Wyhe, M. M., Kunselman, B. L., Leptien, A. D., Wilson, D. M., Eastman, R. C., & Buckingham, B. A. (2004). Use of the Cygnus GlucoWatch biographer at a diabetes camp. Pediatrics, 113(1 Pt 1), 108-111.

clinica.param: DATOS PERDIDOS · Lecturas obtenidas según actividad (sudor/ejercicio)
clinica.valor: reposo 55,6% (exterior) y 66,7% (interior); ejercicio leve 46,6% (exterior) y 29,2% (interior); moderado 11,1%; intenso 0%
clinica.condiciones: 4 DM1 + 5 controles; ejercicio al 40/60/80% de la reserva de frecuencia cardiaca
clinica.cita: Significantly more GlucoWatch readings were obtained during rest (55.6% outdoors, 66.7% indoors) than during moderate (11.1%) or heavy (0%; P < 0.01) exercise.
clinica.fuente: Nunnold, T., Colberg, S. R., Herriott, M. T., & Somma, C. T. (2004). Use of the noninvasive GlucoWatch Biographer during exercise of varying intensity. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 6(4), 454-462.

clinica.param: DATOS PERDIDOS · Motivo de reducción de uso: saltos frecuentes
clinica.condiciones: Grupo GW2B del ensayo aleatorizado de 6 meses (n=99)
clinica.cita: Reasons given for declining use included skin irritation (76%), frequent skips (56%), excessive alarms (47%), and inaccurate readings (33%).
clinica.fuente: Chase, H. P., Beck, R., Tamborlane, W., Buckingham, B., Mauras, N., Tsalikian, E., et al. (2005). A randomized multicenter trial comparing the GlucoWatch Biographer with standard glucose monitoring in children with type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 28(5), 1101-1106.

clinica.param: PIEL · Eritema y edema nulos o leves (estudios de Cygnus)
clinica.condiciones: Ensayos clínicos agregados
clinica.cita: Skin irritation, characterized by erythema and oedema was either nonexistent or mild in over 87% of subjects and resolved in virtually all subjects without treatment in several days.
clinica.fuente: Tierney, M. J., Tamada, J. A., Potts, R. O., Eastman, R. C., Pitzer, K., Ackerman, N. R., & Fermi, S. J. (2000). The GlucoWatch biographer: A frequent automatic and noninvasive glucose monitor. Annals of Medicine, 32(9), 632-641.

clinica.param: PIEL · Eritema y edema nulos o leves (clínica n=231 y casa n=124)
clinica.condiciones: Dos grandes estudios
clinica.cita: Skin irritation, characterized by erythema and edema, was either non-existent or mild in >90% of subjects and resolved in virtually all subjects without treatment in several days.
clinica.fuente: Tierney, M. J., Tamada, J. A., Potts, R. O., Jovanovic, L., Garg, S., & Cygnus Research Team. (2001). Clinical evaluation of the GlucoWatch biographer: A continual, non-invasive glucose monitor for patients with diabetes. Biosensors & Bioelectronics, 16(9-12), 621-629.

clinica.param: PIEL · Reacciones fuertes al parche adhesivo
clinica.condiciones: 66 niños/adolescentes; examen inmediato al retirar y luego periódico
clinica.cita: Two strong reactions to the adhesive pad of the biographer AutoSensor were observed. Most skin reactions were mild.
clinica.fuente: Eastman, R. C., Chase, H. P., Buckingham, B., Hathout, E. H., Fuller-Byk, L., Leptien, A., et al. (2002). Use of the GlucoWatch biographer in children and adolescents with diabetes. Pediatric Diabetes, 3(3), 127-134.

clinica.param: PIEL · Distribución de la puntuación máxima (escala Draize modificada 0-8; 6 = evento adverso reportable)
clinica.valor: máx. 0: 4%; ≤2: 71%; ≤3: 90%; ≤4: 97%; máx. 5 en 3 sujetos; ninguna reacción grave
clinica.condiciones: 89 niños; evaluación al alta; eritema y edema 0-4 c/u
clinica.cita: There were no cases of a serious skin reaction from the GW2B. At the time of hospital discharge, the maximum score for any subject was 5 (3 subjects) on the scale of 0 to 8
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2003). The accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with type 1 diabetes: Results of the diabetes research in children network (DirecNet) accuracy study. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 5(5), 791-800.

clinica.param: PIEL · Irritación moderada con pretratamiento con corticoide (reducción relativa)
clinica.unidad: % de reducción en la fracción con irritación moderada
clinica.condiciones: 66 sujetos con diabetes, ensayo doble ciego aleatorizado en antebrazo, 15 h; efecto persistió a la semana
clinica.cita: with the fraction of subjects who experienced moderate irritation reduced by 57% and 43% for the Kenalog and Cortizone-10 Quick Shot sprays, respectively
clinica.fuente: Tamada, J. A., Davis, T. L., Leptien, A. D., Lee, J., Wang, B., Lopatin, M., Wei, C., Wilson, D., Comyns, K., & Eastman, R. C. (2004). The effect of preapplication of corticosteroids on skin irritation and performance of the GlucoWatch G2 Biographer. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 6(3), 357-367.

clinica.param: PIEL · Abandono por irritación (ensayo de 3 meses)
clinica.valor: 1 de 40 (2 abandonos en total, 1 por irritación)
clinica.condiciones: 40 niños con HbA1c >8%, biógrafo 4 veces/semana por 3 meses y luego observación de 6 meses
clinica.cita: Two children dropped out of the study, 1 because of skin irritation from using the device.
clinica.fuente: Chase, H. P., Roberts, M. D., Wightman, C., Klingensmith, G., Garg, S. K., Van Wyhe, M., et al. (2003). Use of the GlucoWatch biographer in children with type 1 diabetes. Pediatrics, 111(4 Pt 1), 790-794.

clinica.param: PIEL · Irritación cutánea citada como motivo de reducción de uso
clinica.condiciones: Ensayo aleatorizado de 6 meses, 200 sujetos de 7 a <18 años; grupo GW2B
clinica.cita: Reasons given for declining use included skin irritation (76%), frequent skips (56%), excessive alarms (47%), and inaccurate readings (33%).
clinica.fuente: Chase, H. P., Beck, R., Tamborlane, W., Buckingham, B., Mauras, N., Tsalikian, E., et al. (2005). A randomized multicenter trial comparing the GlucoWatch Biographer with standard glucose monitoring in children with type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 28(5), 1101-1106.

clinica.param: PIEL · Cambios agudos a los 6 meses (gravedad)
clinica.valor: 55% con cambios agudos (leves 36%, moderados 19%, graves 0); todos los 99 reportaron irritación al menos una vez
clinica.condiciones: Grupo GW2B de 99 niños de 7-17 años; evaluación estandarizada a los 6 meses
clinica.cita: At the six month visit, 54 (55%) subjects were considered to have acute GW2B-related changes (mild in 36%, moderate in 19%, and severe in 0).
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2005). Youth and parent satisfaction with clinical use of the GlucoWatch G2 Biographer in the management of pediatric type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 28(8), 1929-1935.
clinica.ubicacion: Resultados, Summary of clinical trial results

clinica.param: PIEL · Cambios cutáneos no agudos (costras, piel seca, hipo/hiperpigmentación, cicatrices)
clinica.condiciones: Grupo GW2B, 6 meses
clinica.cita: Non-acute changes (e.g. scabbing, dry skin, hypopigmentation, hyperpigmentation, or scarring) occurred in 50 (51%) children.
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2005). Youth and parent satisfaction with clinical use of the GlucoWatch G2 Biographer in the management of pediatric type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 28(8), 1929-1935.

clinica.param: PIEL · Irritación en niños sanos (GW2B y CGMS)
clinica.valor: no más que mínima en ninguno
clinica.condiciones: 15 niños sanos, 24 h
clinica.cita: None of the subjects experienced more than minimal skin irritation using either the GW2B or the CGMS sensors.
clinica.fuente: Mauras, N., Beck, R. W., Ruedy, K. J., Kollman, C., Tamborlane, W. V., Chase, H. P., et al. (2004). Lack of accuracy of continuous glucose sensors in healthy, nondiabetic children: Results of the Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) accuracy study. The Journal of Pediatrics, 144(6), 770-775.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Alertas de glucosa baja: detección de episodios y falsas alertas
clinica.valor: hasta 75% de los episodios hipoglucémicos detectados, con bajo nivel de falsas alertas
clinica.condiciones: Revisión de estudios clínicos de Cygnus
clinica.cita: The low glucose alert function of the biographer was able to detect up to 75% of hypoglycaemic episodes with a low false alert level.
clinica.fuente: Tierney, M. J., Tamada, J. A., Potts, R. O., Eastman, R. C., Pitzer, K., Ackerman, N. R., & Fermi, S. J. (2000). The GlucoWatch biographer: A frequent automatic and noninvasive glucose monitor. Annals of Medicine, 32(9), 632-641.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Base de datos del análisis de alarma baja y definición de hipoglucemia
clinica.condiciones: 4 ensayos clínicos; alerta verdadera = alarma + glucemia ≤3,9; falsa = alarma + glucemia >3,9
clinica.cita: The analysis was based on 1,091 biographer uses from four clinical trials. which generated 14,487 paired (biographer and blood glucose) readings.
clinica.fuente: Pitzer, K. R., Desai, S., Dunn, T., Edelman, S., Jayalakshmi, Y., Kennedy, J., Tamada, J. A., & Potts, R. O. (2001). Detection of hypoglycemia with the GlucoWatch biographer. Diabetes Care, 24(5), 881-885.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Umbral de alerta óptimo respecto al nivel de preocupación
clinica.valor: 1,1 a 1,7 mmol/L por encima del nivel de preocupación
clinica.condiciones: Análisis ROC por nivel de alerta; el resumen no da sensibilidad/especificidad numéricas; con 2 o 4 mediciones/día se detectan menos eventos
clinica.cita: Setting the alert level from 1.1 to 1.7 mmol/l above the level of concern is likely to optimize the trade-off between true positives and false positives for each user.
clinica.fuente: Pitzer, K. R., Desai, S., Dunn, T., Edelman, S., Jayalakshmi, Y., Kennedy, J., Tamada, J. A., & Potts, R. O. (2001). Detection of hypoglycemia with the GlucoWatch biographer. Diabetes Care, 24(5), 881-885.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Sensibilidad y % de falsas alarmas con alarma a 60 mg/dL
clinica.condiciones: Sensibilidad = % de ref ≤60 con sensor ≤60; falsa = % de sensor ≤60 con ref >60; 91 niños/adolescentes; en 18% de las alarmas ≤60 la referencia fue >80 mg/dL
clinica.cita: Sensitivity to detect hypoglycemia when the GW2B alarm level was set to 60 mg/dl was 23% with a false-alarm rate of 51%.
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2004). Accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 Biographer and the continuous glucose monitoring system during hypoglycemia: Experience of the Diabetes Research in Children Network. Diabetes Care, 27(3), 722-726.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · COMPARADOR CGMS: sensibilidad y falsas alarmas con umbral simulado de 60 mg/dL
clinica.valor: originales: sens. 36, falsas 63; modificados: sens. 49, falsas 58
clinica.condiciones: Se asumió calibración prospectiva hipotética; 401 pares ref ≤60
clinica.cita: the sensor sensitivity for detection of a glucose level ≤60 mg/dL (based on the reference glucose value) would be 36% for the original sensors and 49% for the modified sensors
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2004). Accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 Biographer and the continuous glucose monitoring system during hypoglycemia: Experience of the Diabetes Research in Children Network. Diabetes Care, 27(3), 722-726.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Episodios nocturnos de hipoglucemia notificados por GW2B y confirmados
clinica.condiciones: 23:00-06:00; confirmación con ref ≤60 mg/dL; en los 8 no confirmados la ref mínima fue 75-108 mg/dL. CGMS originales: 30 episodios, 8/26 (31%) confirmados (comparador)
clinica.cita: Hypoglycemia (reference value ≤60 mg/dL) was confirmed in 10 (56%) of the 18 episodes.
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2004). Accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 Biographer and the continuous glucose monitoring system during hypoglycemia: Experience of the Diabetes Research in Children Network. Diabetes Care, 27(3), 722-726.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Umbral de alarma vs sensibilidad y falsas alarmas
clinica.valor: alarma a 120 mg/dL: capta ≥90% de ref ≤60 pero 85% falsas; alarma a 90 mg/dL: detecta 72% de valores ≤70 con 58% falsas
clinica.condiciones: Mismos datos DirecNet; el artículo cita estudio previo de 66 niños: ~90% de sensibilidad y ~70% falsas con alarma a 90 mg/dL
clinica.cita: an alarm level of 90 mg/dL would detect 72% of values ≤70 mg/dL with a false alarm rate of 58%
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2004). Accuracy of the GlucoWatch G2 Biographer and the continuous glucose monitoring system during hypoglycemia: Experience of the Diabetes Research in Children Network. Diabetes Care, 27(3), 722-726.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Sensibilidad en prueba de hipoglucemia: alarma de hipoglucemia sola vs con alerta de caída (down alert)
clinica.condiciones: Umbral simulado 60 mg/dL; hipoglucemia = ref nadir ≤60; 50 GW2B en 34 sujetos; down alert = extrapolación lineal predice ≤60 en 20 min con pendiente ≥0,5%/min
clinica.cita: A hypoglycemia alarm occurred for 12 of the 50 GW2Bs for a sensitivity rate of 24%. However, a down alert alarm occurred for 44 of the 50 GW2Bs, improving sensitivity to 88%.
clinica.fuente: Tsalikian, E., Kollman, C., Mauras, N., Weinzimer, S., Buckingham, B., Xing, D., et al. (2004). GlucoWatch G2 Biographer alarm reliability during hypoglycemia in children. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 6(5), 559-566.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Sensibilidad en prueba de insulina según ventana temporal (alarma de hipo / down alert)
clinica.condiciones: Ventana alrededor del primer momento con ref ≤60 mg/dL; 50 GW2B
clinica.cita: within ± 10 min. of hypoglycemia 2 (4%) ... 23 (46%)
clinica.fuente: Tsalikian, E., Kollman, C., Mauras, N., Weinzimer, S., Buckingham, B., Xing, D., et al. (2004). GlucoWatch G2 Biographer alarm reliability during hypoglycemia in children. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 6(5), 559-566.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Falsos positivos en la prueba de insulina (nadir de referencia >60 mg/dL)
clinica.condiciones: 12 sujetos sin hipoglucemia verdadera, 16 GW2B; nadir de referencia 68-113 mg/dL en los 9 falsos positivos
clinica.cita: A false positive hypoglycemia alarm occurred for 1 (6%) and a false positive down alert alarm occurred for 9 (56%) of the 16 GW2Bs.
clinica.fuente: Tsalikian, E., Kollman, C., Mauras, N., Weinzimer, S., Buckingham, B., Xing, D., et al. (2004). GlucoWatch G2 Biographer alarm reliability during hypoglycemia in children. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 6(5), 559-566.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Desempeño nocturno: sensibilidad por episodios (ref ≤60 mg/dL) con alarma de hipo vs down alert
clinica.valor: durante el episodio: 8% vs 46%; ±30 min: 23% vs 77%
clinica.condiciones: 23:00-06:00; 10 episodios en 9 sujetos, 13 GW2B; umbral 60 mg/dL; con episodios ≤70 mg/dL (35 GW2B): hipo 31% vs down alert 71% durante el episodio
clinica.cita: Only 1 (8%) of the 13 GW2Bs worn by these 9 subjects gave a hypoglycemia alarm (sensor glucose ≤60 mg/dL) during the episode and only 3 (23%) gave an alarm within ±30 minutes
clinica.fuente: Tsalikian, E., Kollman, C., Mauras, N., Weinzimer, S., Buckingham, B., Xing, D., et al. (2004). GlucoWatch G2 Biographer alarm reliability during hypoglycemia in children. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 6(5), 559-566.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Falsas alarmas nocturnas en noches sin hipoglucemia (ref >60 mg/dL toda la noche)
clinica.valor: alarma de hipo 15% de 86 GW2B; down alert 45%; cualquiera 47%
clinica.condiciones: 52 sujetos, 86 GW2B; con ref >70 toda la noche (71 GW2B, 43 sujetos): hipo 3%, down alert 35%, cualquiera 35%
clinica.cita: Only 13 (15%) of these GW2Bs falsely gave a hypoglycemia alarm, but 39 (45%) issued a down alert alarm sometime during the night and 40 (47%) gave at least one alarm of either type.
clinica.fuente: Tsalikian, E., Kollman, C., Mauras, N., Weinzimer, S., Buckingham, B., Xing, D., et al. (2004). GlucoWatch G2 Biographer alarm reliability during hypoglycemia in children. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 6(5), 559-566.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · % de primeras alarmas nocturnas falsas (ref >70 mg/dL continuamente ±30 min)
clinica.valor: alarma de hipo 16% (n=25); down alert 65% (n=68); combinadas 62% (n=69)
clinica.condiciones: 135 GW2B en 81 sujetos; definición con ref >60 continuamente: 60% / 78% / 77%
clinica.cita: 16% of the first hypoglycemia alarms in each GW2B, the interpolated reference glucose was continuously above 70 mg/dL for 30 minutes prior to and 30 minutes following the alarm.
clinica.fuente: Tsalikian, E., Kollman, C., Mauras, N., Weinzimer, S., Buckingham, B., Xing, D., et al. (2004). GlucoWatch G2 Biographer alarm reliability during hypoglycemia in children. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 6(5), 559-566.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Proporción de GW2B con ≥1 alarma nocturna
clinica.condiciones: 135 GW2B nocturnos, umbral 60 mg/dL
clinica.cita: Twenty-five (19%) of the 135 GW2Bs issued at least one hypoglycemia alarm overnight.
clinica.fuente: Tsalikian, E., Kollman, C., Mauras, N., Weinzimer, S., Buckingham, B., Xing, D., et al. (2004). GlucoWatch G2 Biographer alarm reliability during hypoglycemia in children. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 6(5), 559-566.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Alarmas audibles y alarmas que despiertan
clinica.valor: 240 alarmas, 75% durante el sueño; 68% audibles en video; despertó con 29% de alarmas individuales y 66% de eventos de alarma
clinica.condiciones: 20 DM1 de 4-17 años, estancia de ~24 h, 2 GW2B cada uno, videograbación infrarroja 21:00-07:00; alarmas ≤70 y ≥300 mg/dL; evento = alarmas separadas por >30 min
clinica.cita: Subjects awoke to 29% of individual alarms and to 66% of alarm events.
clinica.fuente: Buckingham, B., Block, J., Burdick, J., Kalajian, A., Kollman, C., Choy, M., Wilson, D. M., Chase, P., & Diabetes Research in Children Network. (2005). Response to nocturnal alarms using a real-time glucose sensor. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 7(3), 440-447.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Respuesta por edad y primera alarma
clinica.valor: 4-6 años 17%; 7-11 años 20%; adolescentes 53%; padres 37%; primera alarma de la noche 40% vs posteriores 28%
clinica.condiciones: 20 sujetos, 240 alarmas
clinica.cita: Subjects 4-6 years old responded to 17% of alarms, 7-11 year olds responded to 20% of alarms, adolescents responded to 53% of alarms, and parents responded to 37% of alarms.
clinica.fuente: Buckingham, B., Block, J., Burdick, J., Kalajian, A., Kollman, C., Choy, M., Wilson, D. M., Chase, P., & Diabetes Research in Children Network. (2005). Response to nocturnal alarms using a real-time glucose sensor. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 7(3), 440-447.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Respuesta cuando la hipoglucemia (≤70 mg/dL) fue confirmada
clinica.condiciones: Referencia de laboratorio central
clinica.cita: There were 11 events when the glucose was confirmed to be < or = 70 mg/dL, and in each case the subject was awoken.
clinica.fuente: Buckingham, B., Block, J., Burdick, J., Kalajian, A., Kollman, C., Choy, M., Wilson, D. M., Chase, P., & Diabetes Research in Children Network. (2005). Response to nocturnal alarms using a real-time glucose sensor. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 7(3), 440-447.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Eventos de alarma sin hipo/hiperglucemia confirmada
clinica.condiciones: Alarmas ≤70 o ≥300 mg/dL contra ref de laboratorio
clinica.cita: Fifty-five percent of alarm events occurred when there was no hypo- or hyperglycemia confirmed by a reference glucose value.
clinica.fuente: Buckingham, B., Block, J., Burdick, J., Kalajian, A., Kollman, C., Choy, M., Wilson, D. M., Chase, P., & Diabetes Research in Children Network. (2005). Response to nocturnal alarms using a real-time glucose sensor. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 7(3), 440-447.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Alarmas bajas con medidor correspondiente en campamento
clinica.valor: 20 alarmas: 10 verdaderos positivos, 10 falsos positivos, 0 falsos negativos
clinica.condiciones: 45 campistas, alarma baja a 85 mg/dL, medidor en ≤20 min de la alarma
clinica.cita: Of 20 low-glucose alarms with corresponding meter values measured within 20 minutes, there were 10 true-positive alarms, 10 false-positive alarms, and no false-negative alarms.
clinica.fuente: Gandrud, L. M., Paguntalan, H. U., Van Wyhe, M. M., Kunselman, B. L., Leptien, A. D., Wilson, D. M., Eastman, R. C., & Buckingham, B. A. (2004). Use of the Cygnus GlucoWatch biographer at a diabetes camp. Pediatrics, 113(1 Pt 1), 108-111.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Alarmas que alteran el sueño
clinica.condiciones: 45 campistas, 154 noches
clinica.cita: Campers reported sleep disruption 32% of the nights, and 74% found the biographer helpful.
clinica.fuente: Gandrud, L. M., Paguntalan, H. U., Van Wyhe, M. M., Kunselman, B. L., Leptien, A. D., Wilson, D. M., Eastman, R. C., & Buckingham, B. A. (2004). Use of the Cygnus GlucoWatch biographer at a diabetes camp. Pediatrics, 113(1 Pt 1), 108-111.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Sensibilidad y especificidad de la alarma audible de glucosa baja (uso en casa)
clinica.condiciones: 46 niños DM1 de 1-17 años, 3 meses en casa; 42 episodios detectados por GW2B, 33 confirmados con glucómetro
clinica.cita: Sensitivity and specificity of audible low-glucose alerts were approximately 79% and 83%, respectively.
clinica.fuente: Hathout, E., Patel, N., Southern, C., Hill, J., Anderson, R., Sharkey, J., et al. (2005). Home use of the GlucoWatch G2 biographer in children with diabetes. Pediatrics, 115(3), 662-666.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Alarmas excesivas como motivo de reducción de uso
clinica.condiciones: Grupo GW2B, 6 meses; también lecturas inexactas 33%
clinica.cita: Reasons given for declining use included skin irritation (76%), frequent skips (56%), excessive alarms (47%), and inaccurate readings (33%).
clinica.fuente: Chase, H. P., Beck, R., Tamborlane, W., Buckingham, B., Mauras, N., Tsalikian, E., et al. (2005). A randomized multicenter trial comparing the GlucoWatch Biographer with standard glucose monitoring in children with type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 28(5), 1101-1106.

clinica.param: ALARMAS · Umbral de alarma necesario para especificidad de 70% (GW2B)
clinica.condiciones: Datos de exactitud DirecNet, ROC de hipoglucemia ≤60 mg/dL; AUC se sesga porque el 70% de la curva ROC corresponde a umbrales >125 mg/dL
clinica.cita: the hypoglycemia alarm would need to be set at 125 mg/dL before specificity would be as low as 70%
clinica.fuente: Kollman, C., Wilson, D. M., Wysocki, T., Tamborlane, W. V., Beck, R. W., & Diabetes Research in Children Network Study Group. (2005). Limitations of statistical measures of error in assessing the accuracy of continuous glucose sensors. Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics, 7(5), 665-672.

clinica.param: RESULTADOS CLÍNICOS · HbA1c a los 3 meses (grupo control vs biógrafo, 40 niños)
clinica.valor: basal 8,6 vs 8,9; a 3 meses 8,4 vs 9 (orden como en el resumen); a 6 meses 8,5 y 8,3; a 9 meses 8,6 y 8,4 (control, biógrafo)
clinica.condiciones: 40 niños con HbA1c >8%; control: glucómetro 4/día; biógrafo 4 veces/semana por 3 meses con alertas a ≤70 y ≥300 mg/dL; luego todos recibieron biógrafo 6 meses
clinica.cita: The median HbA1c was 8.6% and 8.9% (control versus biographer) at baseline and was significantly lower in the biographer group after 3 months (8.4% vs 9%).
clinica.fuente: Chase, H. P., Roberts, M. D., Wightman, C., Klingensmith, G., Garg, S. K., Van Wyhe, M., et al. (2003). Use of the GlucoWatch biographer in children with type 1 diabetes. Pediatrics, 111(4 Pt 1), 790-794.

clinica.param: RESULTADOS CLÍNICOS · Hipoglucemia grave (ensayo de 40 niños)
clinica.valor: 0 casos; más hipoglucemia detectada con el biógrafo, sobre todo de noche
clinica.condiciones: Ver arriba
clinica.cita: More hypoglycemia was detected when subjects were wearing the biographer, especially at night. No severe hypoglycemia occurred.
clinica.fuente: Chase, H. P., Roberts, M. D., Wightman, C., Klingensmith, G., Garg, S. K., Van Wyhe, M., et al. (2003). Use of the GlucoWatch biographer in children with type 1 diabetes. Pediatrics, 111(4 Pt 1), 790-794.

clinica.param: RESULTADOS CLÍNICOS · HbA1c a 6 meses, GW2B vs cuidado habitual
clinica.valor: basal 8,0 en ambos; a 6 meses 7,9 (habitual) vs 8,1 (GW2B); IC95% de reducción en GW2B -0,4 a 0,1; P=0,15
clinica.condiciones: 200 sujetos de 7 a <18 años con DM1, 5 centros; GW2B + monitoreo estándar vs monitoreo estándar solo; 6 meses
clinica.cita: at 6 months, HbA1c was 7.9% in the usual care group and 8.1% in the GW2B group (95% CI for mean reduction in the GW2B group compared with the usual care group -0.4 to 0.1%; P = 0.15)
clinica.fuente: Chase, H. P., Beck, R., Tamborlane, W., Buckingham, B., Mauras, N., Tsalikian, E., et al. (2005). A randomized multicenter trial comparing the GlucoWatch Biographer with standard glucose monitoring in children with type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 28(5), 1101-1106.

clinica.param: RESULTADOS CLÍNICOS · Reducción de HbA1c ≥0,5%
clinica.condiciones: Mismo ensayo (n=200)
clinica.cita: A decrease in HbA(1c) of > or =0.5% was achieved in 21% of the usual care group and 28% of the GW2B group (P = 0.29).
clinica.fuente: Chase, H. P., Beck, R., Tamborlane, W., Buckingham, B., Mauras, N., Tsalikian, E., et al. (2005). A randomized multicenter trial comparing the GlucoWatch Biographer with standard glucose monitoring in children with type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 28(5), 1101-1106.

clinica.param: RESULTADOS CLÍNICOS · Hipoglucemia grave a 6 meses
clinica.condiciones: Mismo ensayo (n=200)
clinica.cita: Severe hypoglycemia events occurred in 7% of the GW2B group and in 2% of the usual care group (P = 0.10).
clinica.fuente: Chase, H. P., Beck, R., Tamborlane, W., Buckingham, B., Mauras, N., Tsalikian, E., et al. (2005). A randomized multicenter trial comparing the GlucoWatch Biographer with standard glucose monitoring in children with type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 28(5), 1101-1106.

clinica.param: RESULTADOS CLÍNICOS · HbA1c en grupo GW2B (6 meses)
clinica.condiciones: Grupo GW2B del ensayo, 99 niños; 98 (99%) completaron
clinica.cita: Mean HbA1c was 8.0% at baseline and 8.1% at six months (p=ns).
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2005). Youth and parent satisfaction with clinical use of the GlucoWatch G2 Biographer in the management of pediatric type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 28(8), 1929-1935.
clinica.ubicacion: Resultados, Summary of clinical trial results

clinica.param: RESULTADOS CLÍNICOS · Cambio porcentual medio de HbA1c a 18 meses
clinica.valor: GlucoWatch -1,4; CGMS -4,2 (comparador); control con atención -5,1; cuidado estándar -4,9
clinica.condiciones: 404 adultos >18 años con diabetes con insulina (DM1/DM2), HbA1c ≥7,5% en 2 mediciones, 4 hospitales de Inglaterra; ensayo MITRE de 4 brazos
clinica.cita: Mean percentage changes in HbA1c were -1.4 for the GlucoWatch group, -4.2 for the CGMS group, -5.1 for the attention control group and -4.9 for the standard care control group.
clinica.fuente: Newman, S. P., Cooke, D., Casbard, A., Walker, S., Meredith, S., Nunn, A., et al. (2009). A randomised controlled trial to compare minimally invasive glucose monitoring devices with conventional monitoring in the management of insulin-treated diabetes mellitus (MITRE). Health Technology Assessment, 13(28), iii-iv, ix-xi, 1-194.

clinica.param: RESULTADOS CLÍNICOS · Diferencia en reducción relativa de HbA1c frente a cuidado estándar (intención de tratar, 18 meses)
clinica.valor: GlucoWatch 3,5 (IC95% -1,3 a 8,3); CGMS 0,7 (-4,1 a 5,5, comparador); control con atención -0,1 (-4,6 a 4,3)
clinica.condiciones: 404 adultos; GlucoWatch ≥4 usos/mes mínimo y máx. 4/semana en los primeros 3 meses, luego libre
clinica.cita: differences in mean relative HbA(1c) reduction (95% confidence interval) from baseline to 18 months of 3.5% (-1.3 to 8.3; GlucoWatch), 0.7% (-4.1 to 5.5; CGMS), and -0.1% (-4.6 to 4.3; attention control)
clinica.fuente: Cooke, D., Hurel, S. J., Casbard, A., Steed, L., Walker, S., Meredith, S., et al. (2009). Randomized controlled trial to assess the impact of continuous glucose monitoring on HbA1c in insulin-treated diabetes (MITRE Study). Diabetic Medicine, 26(5), 540-547.

clinica.param: USO REAL · Frecuencia de uso en el tiempo (sensores por semana)
clinica.valor: 2,1 en el mes 1 → 1,5 en el mes 6
clinica.condiciones: Grupo GW2B, ensayo aleatorizado de 6 meses, 7 a <18 años
clinica.cita: In the GW2B group, sensor use declined throughout the study from a mean value of 2.1 times/week in the 1st month to 1.5 times/week in the 6th month.
clinica.fuente: Chase, H. P., Beck, R., Tamborlane, W., Buckingham, B., Mauras, N., Tsalikian, E., et al. (2005). A randomized multicenter trial comparing the GlucoWatch Biographer with standard glucose monitoring in children with type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 28(5), 1101-1106.

clinica.param: USO REAL · Abandono total del GW2B
clinica.valor: 7% a los 3 meses (7/99); 27% a los 6 meses (26/98)
clinica.condiciones: Grupo GW2B, 98 de 99 completaron los 6 meses
clinica.cita: By the third month, 7 (7%) of the 99 subjects stopped using the GW2B and by the sixth month, 26 (27%) of the 98 subjects had done so.
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2005). Youth and parent satisfaction with clinical use of the GlucoWatch G2 Biographer in the management of pediatric type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 28(8), 1929-1935.
clinica.ubicacion: Resultados, Summary of clinical trial results

clinica.param: USO REAL · Sensores con ≥8 h de uso, primer mes
clinica.valor: 1,2 ±0,7 por semana; solo 16% promedió ≥2 usos de ≥8 h por semana; ninguno >4
clinica.condiciones: Grupo GW2B (n=99); se pedía mínimo 4 sensores la primera semana y luego ≥2 por semana
clinica.cita: Only 16% of the subjects averaged at least 2.0 uses of ≥ 8 hours per week and none averaged >4.0 per week.
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2005). Youth and parent satisfaction with clinical use of the GlucoWatch G2 Biographer in the management of pediatric type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 28(8), 1929-1935.

clinica.param: USO REAL · Uso semanal y abandono (análisis psicológico del mismo ensayo)
clinica.condiciones: Grupo GW2B de 99; 73% siguió usándolo hasta el final
clinica.cita: By the end of the study, 27 (27%) of the GW2B subjects had stopped using the device altogether.
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2006). Psychological aspects of continuous glucose monitoring in pediatric type 1 diabetes. Pediatric Diabetes, 7(1), 32-38.

clinica.param: USO REAL · Persistencia de uso a 18 meses
clinica.condiciones: 404 adultos con DM con insulina; el grupo GlucoWatch reportó más efectos secundarios, mayor interferencia con actividades diarias y mayor dificultad de uso
clinica.cita: (20% still using GlucoWatch versus 57% still using the CGMS).
clinica.fuente: Newman, S. P., Cooke, D., Casbard, A., Walker, S., Meredith, S., Nunn, A., et al. (2009). A randomised controlled trial to compare minimally invasive glucose monitoring devices with conventional monitoring in the management of insulin-treated diabetes mellitus (MITRE). Health Technology Assessment, 13(28), iii-iv, ix-xi, 1-194.

clinica.param: USO REAL · Satisfacción: puntaje total CGM-SAT (máximo 185)
clinica.condiciones: 97 padres y 66 jóvenes ≥11 años del grupo GW2B, al final de 6 meses; 37 ítems Likert de 5 puntos; rangos 44-154 (padres) y 54-154 (jóvenes)
clinica.cita: Mean ± 1 SD total scores on the CGM-SAT (maximum possible score 185) were 98.5 ± 23.1 for parents and 98.3 ± 24.1 for youths.
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2005). Youth and parent satisfaction with clinical use of the GlucoWatch G2 Biographer in the management of pediatric type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 28(8), 1929-1935.

clinica.param: USO REAL · Satisfacción: respuestas menos favorables que 'neutral'
clinica.valor: 81% de respuestas de padres; 73% de jóvenes
clinica.condiciones: 30 de 37 ítems (padres) y 27 de 37 (jóvenes) con media <3,0
clinica.cita: Mean scores on CGM-SAT items indicated that 81% of parental responses and 73% of youths' responses were less favorable than "neutral."
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2005). Youth and parent satisfaction with clinical use of the GlucoWatch G2 Biographer in the management of pediatric type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 28(8), 1929-1935.

clinica.param: USO REAL · Ítem 'Es incómodo o doloroso' (de acuerdo + muy de acuerdo)
clinica.valor: jóvenes 76% (55% muy de acuerdo); padres 77% (38% muy de acuerdo); medias 1,8 y 1,9
clinica.condiciones: 66 jóvenes y 97 padres; ítem 16 del CGM-SAT; ítem 'Es más problema que beneficio' con muy de acuerdo 38% (jóvenes) y 39% (padres)
clinica.fuente: Diabetes Research in Children Network (DirecNet) Study Group. (2005). Youth and parent satisfaction with clinical use of the GlucoWatch G2 Biographer in the management of pediatric type 1 diabetes. Diabetes Care, 28(8), 1929-1935.

clinica.param: USO REAL · Utilidad percibida y uso proyectado en campamento
clinica.valor: 74% lo halló útil; usaría 4-5 noches por semana
clinica.condiciones: 45 campistas de 7-17 años
clinica.cita: Campers reported sleep disruption 32% of the nights, and 74% found the biographer helpful. Campers reported they would wear the biographer 4 to 5 nights each week.
clinica.fuente: Gandrud, L. M., Paguntalan, H. U., Van Wyhe, M. M., Kunselman, B. L., Leptien, A. D., Wilson, D. M., Eastman, R. C., & Buckingham, B. A. (2004). Use of the Cygnus GlucoWatch biographer at a diabetes camp. Pediatrics, 113(1 Pt 1), 108-111.
